questions.question: Which question word means "hvor"?
questions.explanation: "Where" means hvor and is used to ask about places.

questions.question: Complete: "___ is your name?"
questions.explanation: We use "What" to ask for information like names: "What is your name?"

questions.question: How do you answer "Do you like pizza?"
questions.explanation: Questions with "Do you...?" are answered with "Yes, I do" or "No, I dont."

questions.question: Which question word means "hvem"?
questions.explanation: "Who" means hvem and is used to ask about people.

questions.question: Complete: "___ old are you?"
questions.explanation: We ask "How old are you?" to find out someones age.
